run_command:@'
name: Build and Release Air Controller

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-windows:
    name: Build Windows Receiver (.NET 10 x64)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET 10 SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"

      - name: Run Receiver Tests
        run: dotnet test windows-receiver/tests/PhoneGamepad.Tests/PhoneGamepad.Tests.csproj -c Release --verbosity normal

      - name: Publish Single-File Executable
        run: dotnet publish windows-receiver/src/PhoneGamepad.Receiver/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o dist/windows/

      - name: Upload Windows Executable Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Receiver-Windows-x64
          path: dist/windows/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-android:
    name: Build Android Controller APK (Debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: "temurin"
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: "8.10.2"

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: android-controller
        run: gradle :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Android APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Android-Debug-APK
          path: android-controller/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

  release:
    name: Publish GitHub Release
    needs: [build-windows, build-android]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Create Release Assets Directory
        run: mkdir -p release-assets

      - name: Download Windows Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Receiver-Windows-x64
          path: release-assets

      - name: Download Android Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Android-Debug-APK
          path: release-assets

      - name: Verify Artifacts
        run: |
          ls -la release-assets
          test -f release-assets/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe || exit 1
          test -f release-assets/app-debug.apk || exit 1

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v1.0.0
          name: "Air Controller v1.0.0 (Debug APK & Windows Executable)"
          body: |
            # Air Controller - Phone-as-Gamepad v1.0.0

            Complete Phone-as-Gamepad client and Windows receiver release.

            ### Downloadable Assets
            - **`PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe`** (Windows x64): Standalone, self-contained single-file receiver. No .NET runtime installation required.
            - **`app-debug.apk`** (Android): Touch HUD game controller with custom layout editor, zero-permission QR pairing, and 120 Hz UDP transmission.

            ### Quick Installation & Usage
            1. **Windows PC**:
               - Run `PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe` as Administrator (required for Win32 SendInput and UIPI bypass with elevated games).
               - Select your game process from the dropdown (or leave blank to target whatever game has focus).
               - Click **Arm Receiver** (or use the emergency kill switch `Ctrl+Alt+F12` to toggle).
               - Keep the pairing QR code open on your screen.
            2. **Android Phone**:
               - Install and open `app-debug.apk`.
               - Tap **Pair Controller** and scan the QR code displayed on your PC screen.
               - Enjoy zero-latency gaming controls with customizable HUD layouts!
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: |
            release-assets/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe
            release-assets/app-debug.apk
'@ | Out-File -FilePath .github/workflows/build-and-release.yml -Encoding utf8 -Force:sha256(44136fa3)

﻿package com.gamepad.controller.model

/**
 * Authoritative wire protocol constants per PLAN.md Rev 4 Section 9 and .okf/nodes/schemas.md.
 */
object ProtocolConstants {
    // Protocol Identification
    const val MAGIC: UShort = 0x5047u // 'G' (0x47), 'P' (0x50) in Little-Endian: byte 0 = 0x47, byte 1 = 0x50
    const val VERSION: UByte = 1u
    const val DEFAULT_PORT: Int = 47789

    // Frame Sizing
    const val HEADER_SIZE: Int = 12
    const val MAC_SIZE: Int = 8

    // Packet Types
    const val TYPE_INPUT_KBM: UByte = 0u
    const val TYPE_RUMBLE: UByte = 1u
    const val TYPE_PING: UByte = 2u
    const val TYPE_PONG: UByte = 3u
    const val TYPE_HELLO: UByte = 4u
    const val TYPE_HELLO_ACK: UByte = 5u
    const val TYPE_BYE: UByte = 6u
    const val TYPE_INPUT_PAD: UByte = 7u
    const val TYPE_STATUS: UByte = 8u

    // Total Packet Lengths (Header 12 + Payload + MAC 8)
    const val LEN_INPUT_KBM: Int = 46    // 12 + 26 + 8
    const val LEN_RUMBLE: Int = 22       // 12 + 2 + 8
    const val LEN_PING: Int = 28         // 12 + 8 + 8
    const val LEN_PONG: Int = 28         // 12 + 8 + 8
    const val LEN_HELLO: Int = 36        // 12 + 16 + 8
    const val LEN_HELLO_ACK: Int = 36    // 12 + 16 + 8
    const val LEN_BYE: Int = 20          // 12 + 0 + 8
    const val LEN_INPUT_PAD: Int = 32    // 12 + 12 + 8
    const val LEN_STATUS: Int = 21       // 12 + 1 + 8

    // Mouse Button Bitmasks (Offset 16 in input_kbm payload)
    const val MOUSE_NONE: UByte = 0x00u
    const val MOUSE_LMB: UByte = 0x01u
    const val MOUSE_RMB: UByte = 0x02u
    const val MOUSE_MMB: UByte = 0x04u
    const val MOUSE_X1: UByte = 0x08u
    const val MOUSE_X2: UByte = 0x10u

    // Status Flags Bitmasks (Offset 0 in status payload)
    const val STATUS_ARMED: UByte = 0x01u
    const val STATUS_TARGET_FOCUSED: UByte = 0x02u
    const val STATUS_KBM_AVAILABLE: UByte = 0x04u
    const val STATUS_GAMEPAD_AVAILABLE: UByte = 0x08u
}

name: Build and Release Air Controller

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-windows:
    name: Build Windows Receiver (.NET 10 x64)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET 10 SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"

      - name: Run Receiver Tests
        run: dotnet test windows-receiver/tests/PhoneGamepad.Tests/PhoneGamepad.Tests.csproj -c Release --verbosity normal

      - name: Publish Single-File Executable
        run: dotnet publish windows-receiver/src/PhoneGamepad.Receiver/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o dist/windows/

      - name: Upload Windows Executable Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Receiver-Windows-x64
          path: dist/windows/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-android:
    name: Build Android Controller APK (Debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: "temurin"
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: "8.10.2"

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: android-controller
        run: gradle :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Android APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Android-Debug-APK
          path: android-controller/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

  release:
    name: Publish GitHub Release
    needs: [build-windows, build-android]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Create Release Assets Directory
        run: mkdir -p release-assets

      - name: Download Windows Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Receiver-Windows-x64
          path: release-assets

      - name: Download Android Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Android-Debug-APK
          path: release-assets

      - name: Verify Artifacts
        run: |
          ls -la release-assets
          test -f release-assets/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe || exit 1
          test -f release-assets/app-debug.apk || exit 1

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v1.0.0
          name: "Air Controller v1.0.0 (Debug APK & Windows Executable)"
          body: |
            # Air Controller - Phone-as-Gamepad v1.0.0

            Complete Phone-as-Gamepad client and Windows receiver release.

            ### Downloadable Assets
            - **`PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe`** (Windows x64): Standalone, self-contained single-file receiver. No .NET runtime installation required.
            - **`app-debug.apk`** (Android): Touch HUD game controller with custom layout editor, zero-permission QR pairing, and 120 Hz UDP transmission.

            ### Quick Installation & Usage
            1. **Windows PC**:
               - Run `PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe` as Administrator (required for Win32 SendInput and UIPI bypass with elevated games).
               - Select your game process from the dropdown (or leave blank to target whatever game has focus).
               - Click **Arm Receiver** (or use the emergency kill switch `Ctrl+Alt+F12` to toggle).
               - Keep the pairing QR code open on your screen.
            2. **Android Phone**:
               - Install and open `app-debug.apk`.
               - Tap **Pair Controller** and scan the QR code displayed on your PC screen.
               - Enjoy zero-latency gaming controls with customizable HUD layouts!
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: |
            release-assets/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe
            release-assets/app-debug.apk
'@ | Out-File -FilePath .github/workflows/build-and-release.yml -Encoding utf8 -Force:sha256(44136fa3)

run_command:@'
name: Build and Release Air Controller

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-windows:
    name: Build Windows Receiver (.NET 10 x64)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET 10 SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"

      - name: Run Receiver Tests
        run: dotnet test windows-receiver/tests/PhoneGamepad.Tests/PhoneGamepad.Tests.csproj -c Release --verbosity normal

      - name: Publish Single-File Executable
        run: dotnet publish windows-receiver/src/PhoneGamepad.Receiver/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o dist/windows/

      - name: Upload Windows Executable Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Receiver-Windows-x64
          path: dist/windows/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-android:
    name: Build Android Controller APK (Debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: "temurin"
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: "8.10.2"

      - name: Accept Android SDK Licenses
        run: |
          yes | $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses || true

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: android-controller
        run: |
          gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.10.2
          ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace --no-daemon

      - name: Upload Android APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Android-Debug-APK
          path: android-controller/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

  release:
    name: Publish GitHub Release
    needs: [build-windows, build-android]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Create Release Assets Directory
        run: mkdir -p release-assets

      - name: Download Windows Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Receiver-Windows-x64
          path: release-assets

      - name: Download Android Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Android-Debug-APK
          path: release-assets

      - name: Verify Artifacts
        run: |
          ls -la release-assets
          test -f release-assets/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe || exit 1
          test -f release-assets/app-debug.apk || exit 1

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v1.0.0
          name: "Air Controller v1.0.0 (Debug APK & Windows Executable)"
          body: |
            # Air Controller - Phone-as-Gamepad v1.0.0

            Complete Phone-as-Gamepad client and Windows receiver release.

            ### Downloadable Assets
            - **`PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe`** (Windows x64): Standalone, self-contained single-file receiver. No .NET runtime installation required.
            - **`app-debug.apk`** (Android): Touch HUD game controller with custom layout editor, zero-permission QR pairing, and 120 Hz UDP transmission.

            ### Quick Installation & Usage
            1. **Windows PC**:
               - Run `PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe` as Administrator (required for Win32 SendInput and UIPI bypass with elevated games).
               - Select your game process from the dropdown (or leave blank to target whatever game has focus).
               - Click **Arm Receiver** (or use the emergency kill switch `Ctrl+Alt+F12` to toggle).
               - Keep the pairing QR code open on your screen.
            2. **Android Phone**:
               - Install and open `app-debug.apk`.
               - Tap **Pair Controller** and scan the QR code displayed on your PC screen.
               - Enjoy zero-latency gaming controls with customizable HUD layouts!
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: |
            release-assets/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe
            release-assets/app-debug.apk
'@ | Out-File -FilePath .github/workflows/build-and-release.yml -Encoding utf8 -Force:sha256(44136fa3)

name: Build and Release Air Controller

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-windows:
    name: Build Windows Receiver (.NET 10 x64)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET 10 SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: "10.0.x"

      - name: Run Receiver Tests
        run: dotnet test windows-receiver/tests/PhoneGamepad.Tests/PhoneGamepad.Tests.csproj -c Release --verbosity normal

      - name: Publish Single-File Executable
        run: dotnet publish windows-receiver/src/PhoneGamepad.Receiver/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o dist/windows/

      - name: Upload Windows Executable Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Receiver-Windows-x64
          path: dist/windows/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-android:
    name: Build Android Controller APK (Debug)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: "temurin"
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Setup Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: "8.10.2"

      - name: Accept Android SDK Licenses
        run: |
          yes | $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses || true

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: android-controller
        run: |
          gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.10.2
          ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --stacktrace --no-daemon

      - name: Upload Android APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Android-Debug-APK
          path: android-controller/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error

  release:
    name: Publish GitHub Release
    needs: [build-windows, build-android]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Create Release Assets Directory
        run: mkdir -p release-assets

      - name: Download Windows Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Receiver-Windows-x64
          path: release-assets

      - name: Download Android Artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: PhoneGamepad-Android-Debug-APK
          path: release-assets

      - name: Verify Artifacts
        run: |
          ls -la release-assets
          test -f release-assets/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe || exit 1
          test -f release-assets/app-debug.apk || exit 1

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: v1.0.0
          name: "Air Controller v1.0.0 (Debug APK & Windows Executable)"
          body: |
            # Air Controller - Phone-as-Gamepad v1.0.0

            Complete Phone-as-Gamepad client and Windows receiver release.

            ### Downloadable Assets
            - **`PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe`** (Windows x64): Standalone, self-contained single-file receiver. No .NET runtime installation required.
            - **`app-debug.apk`** (Android): Touch HUD game controller with custom layout editor, zero-permission QR pairing, and 120 Hz UDP transmission.

            ### Quick Installation & Usage
            1. **Windows PC**:
               - Run `PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe` as Administrator (required for Win32 SendInput and UIPI bypass with elevated games).
               - Select your game process from the dropdown (or leave blank to target whatever game has focus).
               - Click **Arm Receiver** (or use the emergency kill switch `Ctrl+Alt+F12` to toggle).
               - Keep the pairing QR code open on your screen.
            2. **Android Phone**:
               - Install and open `app-debug.apk`.
               - Tap **Pair Controller** and scan the QR code displayed on your PC screen.
               - Enjoy zero-latency gaming controls with customizable HUD layouts!
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          files: |
            release-assets/PhoneGamepad.Receiver.exe
            release-assets/app-debug.apk
'@ | Out-File -FilePath .github/workflows/build-and-release.yml -Encoding utf8 -Force:sha256(44136fa3)
